# extract the two assignment helpers before build_image
helper = '''
def _assign(root, policy):
    if policy == 'top':
        stack = [root]
        while stack:
            n = stack.pop()
            n.stage = 10 - n.level
            stack.extend(n.children)
        return
    def compute(n):
        if not n.children:
            n.stage = 0
            return 0
        cs = [compute(c) for c in n.children]
        m = max(cs)
        if n.type == 3:
            for c in n.children: c.stage = m   # bulk roots share one stage
        n.stage = m + 1
        return m + 1
    compute(root)

'''
